purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for one ordinary Low Sere return-shard closing. This is website collateral and a visual lore stress test, not canonical event state.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the Upper Shelf, ordinary water-and-shard closure, the failed fit, witnessed comparison, final allocation of cost, and four outcome families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the wide Upper Shelf, the three-person routine, the preparation choice, the ordinary fold, the one-sentence mismatch, the comparison choice, the open-claim fold, the final threshold, and each ending family. The failed fit stands alone before dispute.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base prompt states complete visible geometry, materials, light, weather, bodies, tools, and props for a general image model. Fictional terms are described visibly. Continuity notes remain reviewer constraints and never enter prompt assembly.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Hand-painted high-fantasy interactive-fiction illustration, gouache and fine ink on textured paper, restrained twilight palette of cold slate, grey clay, faded moss green, warm amber, and mineral white, tactile working surfaces, expressive human posture, legible object-centered staging, dry humane mood, unlettered abstract marks.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups actually visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Omit absent refs. Use the scene_set camera slot or a camera-specific blockout for consistent replay.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture uses several angles in one small outdoor work area. The structured map fixes sheds, awning, marker, bench, water vessel, upper track, basin stair, and search zones for draft replay.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout from this map and render each named camera slot as image-generation input.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view down onto a narrow stone shelf above a misty high-fantasy settlement in permanent twilight. Three squat guest sheds of dark fitted stone lean into the uphill slope beneath one patched grey awning. A waist-high dark road marker stands at the exposed shelf lip beside a worn track; its face has rows of shallow sockets holding broken grey pottery halves. A low witness bench, a covered grey-clay water vessel, a parked two-wheeled handcart, coils of load cord, rivets, lamp hooks, and repaired pans make the shelf a working traveller halt. Warm white mist rises from covered cistern roofs and stepped dwellings below. A small departure group of three cloaked human travellers tightens straps on two handcarts along the upper track.

visible_characters.default_stance: three distant cloaked adults tightening handcart loads on the upper track

visual_continuity_notes: The three sheds occupy the uphill/back edge. The marker and bench occupy the exposed/downhill lip. The upper track crosses behind the marker; a basin stair descends beyond the bench.
Permanent twilight provides cool ambient light. One hooded shelf lamp provides warm local light at the marker.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable scene-bounded visual identities for recurring named characters and the departure group. Include only refs for people visible in a frame.

characters.sava_ren: Sava Ren: baseline human travelling small-goods seller, lean adult build, medium height, brown skin, short close black curls, narrow expressive face, weathered ochre outer cloak over layered grey travel clothes, sturdy dark boots, packed travel roll, cord at the throat carrying one thumb-long grey pottery half, practical quick hands, posture often divided between the road and the object under discussion.
characters.olan_ves: Olan Ves: baseline human Grey Bed worker and local sponsor, sturdy broad adult build, dark brown skin, short tightly curled hair threaded with grey, faded moss-green wrap over practical dark work layers, cuffs and broad hands stained with pale mineral ash and plant residue, grounded stance, embarrassment shown by looking toward work or road before speaking.
characters.nemi_cal: Nemi Cal: baseline human Low Sere water witness, compact adult build, light brown skin with wind-reddened cheeks, one long dark braid, slate-blue wool layers under a short grey shoulder cape, narrow belt with stylus and small marked cup, careful clean fingertips, still posture that keeps each object attributable.

groups.upper_shelf_departure_group: Upper Shelf departure group: three baseline human adult travellers in layered charcoal, muted blue, and brown road cloaks, faces mostly shadowed by practical hoods, pulling two low two-wheeled handcarts bound with woven cords and grey blankets; small distant silhouettes used as a visible clock, never the owners of the shard dispute.
